text_to_image_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original landscape scene asset, 1536x1024, full-bleed independent image for an interactive story environment library. Composition must provide an uncluttered foreground and layered environmental depth. Entire scene is unoccupied: absolutely no people, characters, silhouettes, human reflections, portraits, statues, mannequins, humanoid robots, animals, birds, fish or insects. Plants and flowers allowed. No text, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, borders or collage. Follow the specified medium faithfully, with an attractive coherent palette and legible architecture. Optimistic retro-futurist screenprint travel-poster artwork, empty lakeside spaceport and elegant slim rocket on a launch pad, low curved terminal, huge ringed planet above distant hills, tomato-red structures against turquoise lake and creamy yellow sky, limited inks and tasteful print grain, no words or branding.
